title: コンクリート製輪止め
description: 固定用貫通穴と両側の黄色い反射板を備える面取りされたコンクリート製輪止め。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A chamfered precast parking wheel stop with real through-fixing bores and yellow reflectors on both slopes. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.

provenance.rights: Original geometry and material design created for Xenoah Meshcopia under the owner request for CC-BY-4.0 publication. No third-party meshes, scans, brands, logos or font files.

usages.context: Original city asset created for this library. No external deployment or reuse claimed.
